subject.title: feat(plugins): add manifest-first host contribution bundles

question: Should OpenClaw establish `hostIntegrationBundle` as a permanent external plugin-manifest contract, or should host contribution grouping remain outside core or evolve through the existing manifest contract model?
rationale: The patch is intentionally inert and technically bounded, but choosing a new versioned plugin-manifest surface determines a long-lived external compatibility contract that source review cannot safely decide.

options.title: Sponsor the manifest contract
options.body: Approve the new field as the canonical host-bundle inventory surface and require its intended consumers and compatibility guarantees to be documented before merge.

options.title: Evolve an existing contract surface
options.body: Decline a parallel field and ask for a narrow proposal that proves the current `contracts` model cannot represent the required atomic versioned grouping.

options.title: Keep the capability external
options.body: Leave the grouping in the owning external plugin until a concrete core consumer demonstrates a missing extension seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the manifest contract
recommendation.body: Approve the new field as the canonical host-bundle inventory surface and require its intended consumers and compatibility guarantees to be documented before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the proposal's required consumer and why existing manifest contracts are insufficient, while final API direction needs an OpenClaw plugin owner.
